main_text.l: nis & Gelasii, quæ à Ferrando nusquam
hoc discrimine, quod Cresconius has septem
synodos ex editione Dionysii Exigui iis-
dem verbis & numeris exhibeat, non item
Ferrandus, qui codicibus usus est in utro-
diu unum ante alium suam collectionem
perfecisse. In Ferrando quoque diversi sunt
eo nata est, quod omnes pariter collectio-
sunt; Græci enim, itemque Dionysius Exi-
guus omnes CXXXIII. una serie numera-
runt, tanquam unius synodi, ut revera sunt.
Alii vero ex una synodo quasi duas fece-
runt, nec eodem plane modo. Nam Co-
dex vetus canonum Ecclesiæ Romanæ edi-tus

page.notes: Page number "169" is in the running head line at top right (printed as "169"); the foot figure "15" is a signature-like mark, read as "15" but doubtful. Catchword "tus" is a continuation of "edi-tus" split across the foot; left as printed. Some letters in the scan are blurred (e.g. "Dionysii", "Carthaginiensium") but read with reasonable confidence.
